recentItems.description:
Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu addressed the media in Amaravati regarding the impact of Cyclone Arnab and the damage caused across the state. During the press meet, he assured that justice would be delivered to everyone who suffered crop losses and property damage due to the cyclone. He highlighted the government's commitment to supporting affected farmers and families through necessary relief measures. Watch this latest Andhra Pradesh news update for Chandrababu Naidu's key statements on cyclone damage, farmer compensation, and government assistance.
